description.en: DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。

Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory. v0.11 added a bilingual settings panel whose copy and sidebar label follow DSH language setting (中文「记忆」/ English "Memory"); v0.12 added the shared cross-plugin speech floor, a context-sensitive tone section and a weekly growth recap; v0.13 declares its DSH compatibility via engines.dsh (official 0.2.1-rc.5 series; older hosts are refused by the gate), adds a "Review now" button (POST /api/memory/control, action growth-now) that sends one growth recap immediately while still respecting the speech floor, panel accessibility (aria labels, status and alert roles, focus-visible rings), and the public PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md. v0.14 adds per-session memory: a composer chip with a dropdown (this session / workspace default), the /memory on|off|status command, and a settings-panel switch all flip the same gate — off means no boot injection, no digest/recall nudges and no last_access stamping for that session (nothing is deleted); disabledWorkspaces lets whole projects default to off, and session choices persist for 7 days. v0.15 adds a Basic soul (quick forging) card: my name / what I call you / baseline persona, saved into a managed block inside SOUL.md (the rest of the file is left untouched) and marks BOOTSTRAP complete; existing chat-forged souls are echoed from the SOUL text, and the boot block now asks the agent to remind the user to forge first when no soul exists yet. v0.16 turns the memory graph into an interactive 3D sphere (Canvas, zero dependency): drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, drag nodes to arrange them in 3D, double-click empty space to reset, auto-spin (reduced-motion aware); hover or click a node to instantly light up its neighbours (displacement+duration click threshold), and colours adapt to light/dark panel themes. v0.17 adds graph search (ranked matches, the camera flies to the hit and lights up its neighbours), Reveal in Finder / Copy path for any node (the host command is awaited, and the absolute path is copied automatically when reveal fails), Windows support (path-variable expansion, CRLF parsing with style-preserving writes, explorer /select, argv and exit-code handling, case-insensitive workspace matching), plus a much shorter README with real screenshots. v0.18 (issue #8) adds a boot snapshot mode: session freezes the boot block for the session so mid-session memory writes no longer invalidate the prompt-prefix cache (the volatile recent-log tail now rides in its own late context segment), with live kept as the default; double-clicking a memory node now opens the note in the DSH right sidebar (falling back to Finder/Explorer).
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。 v0.11 起设置面板与侧栏 label 跟随 DSH 语言设置（中文「记忆」/英文 "Memory"）；v0.12 新增跨插件共享发言权、按语境微调的语气段与每周成长回顾；v0.13 用 engines.dsh 声明 DSH 兼容范围（官方 0.2.1-rc.5 系列，旧宿主会被闸门拒绝），新增「立即回顾」按钮（POST /api/memory/control，action growth-now，立即发一次成长回顾且仍尊重发言权）、面板可访问性（aria-label、status/alert role、focus-visible 焦点环）与公开的 PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md。v0.14 新增按会话记忆开关：输入框芯片（下拉可选本会话 / 此工作区默认）、/memory on|off|status 命令与设置面板开关共用同一判定——关闭后该会话不注入 boot 块、不发 digest/追忆提醒、不盖 last_access（记忆文件不删）；disabledWorkspaces 可让整个项目默认关闭，会话选择持久化 7 天。v0.15 新增「人格基础（快速铸魂）」卡片：我的名字 / 你的称呼 / 基础人格描述，保存写入 SOUL.md 受管区块（其余内容一字不动）并把 BOOTSTRAP 标 complete；对话铸魂的老库会从 SOUL 文本回显，未铸魂时 boot 块会先提醒用户完成铸魂。v0.16 把记忆图谱升级为可交互 3D 球面（Canvas 手绘、零依赖）：拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放、拖节点 3D 整理布局、双击空白重置、自动慢转（尊重减少动态效果）；悬停或点击节点即时高亮邻居（位移+时长点击阈值），配色随浅色/深色面板自适应。v0.17 新增图谱搜索（排序匹配，镜头飞到命中的节点并点亮邻居）、节点的「在 Finder 中显示 / 复制路径」（等待命令结果，失败自动复制路径兜底）、Windows 兼容（路径变量展开、CRLF 读写保留换行风格、explorer 参数与退出码处理、工作区大小写匹配），README 精简并加入真实截图。v0.18（issue #8）新增 boot 快照模式：session 在本会话固化 boot 块，会话中途写记忆不再让前缀缓存失效（最近动态改走独立的靠后 context 段），默认仍是 live；双击记忆节点改为在 DSH 右侧栏打开该文件（打不开时回退系统文件管理器）。

description.en: DSH 壁纸引擎：本机 WE 壁纸实时渲染，视频/网页/开机动画/桌宠皮肤，一键拉取在线素材。

Run one instruction on every online Windows and macOS machine, across networks and regions: a dependency-free relay talks to each machine over outbound connections only (Tailscale, a public VPS behind TLS, or a tunnel), every machine runs the command in its own checkout, and results come back with a commit, a working-tree fingerprint and a command hash so an environment mismatch is reported as unverifiable instead of being mistaken for a different result. Sending work needs its own operator token, separate from the per-machine device token.
description.zh: 一条指令同时下发给所有在线的 Windows 与 macOS 机器，可跨网络跨区域：零依赖中继只通过出站连接与各机通信（Tailscale 内网、公网 VPS + TLS、或隧道），各机在各自的项目副本上执行，结果连同 commit、工作区指纹与命令哈希一并回传，因此"环境不一致"会被判为 unverifiable，而不会被误当成结果分歧。下发指令需要独立于设备令牌的 operator token。

description.en: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.
description.zh: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水位并开关代码骨架压缩；基于 DeepSeek V4 官方 tokenizer 的精确计量与同修订计数校验；非支持模型自动 fail-open，保留原始工具结果。回合内支持骨架化信息压缩、低原文取回率；turn 尾部支持尾部意图摘要（turn-tail intent summary）且仅以内容替代方式实现；上下文内容安全，全程在官方 jsonl 压缩内。

description.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.
description.zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。

description.en: Desktop-native BigFish companion for DeepSeek Harness — real Agent status, always on top on Windows.
description.zh: 桌面原生陪伴工具，在Windows上实时显示代理状态并保持置顶。

description.en: Officially connects QQ Bot to DeepSeek Harness, enabling chat-based interactions through the popular messaging platform.
description.zh: 让 QQ Bot 接入 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的官方插件

description.en: Adaptive reasoning slider skin that maps each model's available reasoning efforts onto a 0–30 visual intensity scale, with synchronized portraits, background, and interface colors.
description.zh: 自适应推理等级滑块皮肤，将当前模型可用档位映射到 0–30 视觉强度，并同步人物、背景和界面配色。

description.en: Nothing stays in the system prompt: a hit returns titles only, a body loads only when read, and project rules can grow themselves.
description.zh: 让东坡肉滚出系统提示：记忆不常驻，命中只给标题，正文读了才进上下文，项目规范还能自己长。

description.en: The shared UI foundation for DSH plugins, with a live component preview: design tokens, common controls, workspace browsing and notifications maintained in one place — install it to preview every component in a real host.
Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to IM platforms like WeChat, DingTalk, QQ, and Feishu for seamless messaging.
description.zh: DSH IM Connect 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的IM链接插件，无缝链接微信、企业微信、钉钉、QQ、飞书等

description.en: Provides lightweight context management to keep essential memory active without heavy overhead.
description.zh: 提供轻量级上下文管理，保持关键记忆活跃且不增加过多负担。

description.en: Provides a plugin marketplace within DSH to search, download, and install community plugins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区内置插件市场（dsh-plugin）— 搜索插件、下载并安装 4000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新、完全免费。内置在 Harness「设置 → 插件中心」，无需离开应用即可浏览、搜索、安装各类 AI 插件。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory as a local SQLite store: dual scopes (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval fused with RRF, an evidence gate that forces an explicit sufficiency judgement, provenance audit chains, SM-2 spaced-repetition review, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a nine-view "Memory Palace" sidebar panel. 22 narrow-parameter tools, no external service, no API key, no Docker.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆，纯本地 SQLite：双层分库（用户级 + 按 git origin 隔离的项目级）、FTS5 + 本地向量 RRF 融合检索、强制给出充分性判定的证据门、来源审计链、SM-2 间隔重复复习、巩固蒸馏与衰减遗忘，以及九视图「记忆宫殿」侧栏面板。22 个窄参数工具，无外部服务、无 API Key、无 Docker。

description.en: A draggable Live2D desktop pet for the DSH web GUI that tracks the pointer, changes motion, expression and outfit with the session phase, and opens a right-click control panel.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠：可拖动、跟随鼠标，跟着会话状态换动作、表情与装扮，右键呼出控制面板。

description.en: Scopes memory capture to specific projects or sessions, enabling targeted and organized long-term recall.
description.zh: 将记忆捕获限定在特定项目或会话内，实现精准且有组织的长期回顾。

description.en: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.
description.zh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

description.en: Shows a card in the sidebar footer with the DeepSeek account balance (read from the official /user/balance endpoint with the API key DSH already stores) and the unit prices of the active model — input, cache read and output — taken from a built-in snapshot of the official price table. A dot marks the current billing window and a countdown shows the time left until it flips: peak is Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing Time, excluding Chinese public holidays, and everything else is off-peak. Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示一张卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额（用 DSH 已保存的 API Key 调官方 /user/balance 接口获取），以及当前模型的档单价——输入、缓存读取、输出——取自内置的官方价格表快照。一个圆点标出当前计费时段，旁边是距离切换的倒计时：高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余为空闲时段。档单价与圆点只对 DeepSeek 官方模型显示，其他模型只显示余额。卡片每 30 秒刷新一次，点击或切换模型时立即刷新，并跟随应用主题与 DSH 语言。

description.en: Automatically captures and stores runtime context and project documents for persistent, searchable memory across sessions.
description.zh: 自动捕获运行时上下文和项目文档，实现跨会话的持久化、可搜索记忆。

description.en: ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT 账号登录：走 Codex 浏览器 OAuth，无需 API Key、无需选择工作空间；把登录结果接到 pi-ai 的 Codex provider，可设置新会话默认的 Codex 模型与思考强度，并按账号自己的目录接口刷新模型列表，在输入区展示 5 小时与每周用量窗口。

description.en: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.
description.zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。

description.en: fnOS 飞牛 NAS integration for DeepSeek Harness, working through the fnOS browser SDK when the Web UI runs inside an fnOS app frame: follows the NAS theme while DSH is set to system preference, lists and revokes authorized NAS directory grants in Settings, opens files and links in the matching fnOS app, and syncs the DSH page title to the fnOS app window. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进飞牛 fnOS：DSH 界面跑在 fnOS 应用框架里时通过 fnOS 浏览器 SDK 工作——DSH 设为跟随系统时读取并跟随 NAS 主题，在设置里列出和取消已授权的 NAS 目录，把文件与链接交给对应的 fnOS 应用打开，并把 DSH 页面标题同步到 fnOS 应用窗口。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`。

description.en: Proactive associative memory for DSH: zero-prompt recall injected at a fixed boundary, three-layer auto-consolidation, skill crystallization, and Astra-style context management - handoff ledgers and a PLAN whiteboard that survive context-window switches, water-level sensing with an auto-detected model window. Local Markdown storage, model-agnostic, zero deps; lexical 0GB floor with optional semantic tiers.
description.zh: 主动联想记忆 + Astra 式上下文管理：自动唤回（固定边界注入，前缀缓存友好）/自动沉淀/技能固化/交接账本与 PLAN 白板跨窗口续命/水位感知（窗口自动适配当前模型）。本地 Markdown 存储，模型无关，零依赖；词法 0GB 兜底，可选语义档。

description.en: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.
description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: in-place conversation rewind in the same session window (Claude Code /rewind semantics) + optional file restore
description.zh: 在会话窗口内原地回退对话，并可选择恢复文件到先前状态。

description.en: HuaweiCloud DevKit gives AI agents complete command of Huawei Cloud — build, deploy, operate, always governed, always secure.
description.zh: 让 AI 智能体掌握华为云全流程操作——构建、部署、运维全程受控，助您轻松安全上云。

description.en: Unifies long-term memory, knowledge retrieval, and skills into a self-evolving context database for agents.
description.zh: 整合长期记忆、知识检索与技能，为智能体提供自演进的上下文数据库。

description.en: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.
description.zh: 自带独立索引的侧边栏会话搜索（不再复用 DSH 官方全文索引）：一处入口在标题与内容检索间切换，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与 用户/回复/工具 类型标签；水位驱动增量同步、按归档集合清理已归档会话，整理走影子索引不阻塞在用索引。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.

One-click polish, expand and autopilot for the DeepSeek Harness composer: rewrite the draft with the model the session is switched to, expand a one-line wish into a task brief without asking questions, or let an AI drive a goal round after round.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一键润色、扩写和自动驾驶，写东西更省心。

description.en: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.
description.zh: 高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停（全局）+ 会话级冻结/恢复 + 后端自动重试；错峰自动续跑。

description.en: One header button stops running turns, goals and background jobs and writes the plan to disk; after a restart the same button picks the work up again.
description.zh: 会话头一个按钮停掉回合、目标和后台任务，写盘；重启后同一个按钮把工作接回来。

description.en: Turn any DSH selection into a reviewable quote — chat, file preview, terminal and diff; code quotes carry path#line. A sent quote keeps a source highlight and ordinal and jumps back, then joins a searchable review list with status, tags, multi-select insert, and Markdown/JSON export. Quotes collect above the composer as a 引用 ×N bar with per-chip edit and remove; side threads can bring their conclusion back to the main draft; a sent quote can be revised, with the old capsule marked superseded; replies can answer each quote by number.
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的任意选区变成可审阅的引用对象：正文、文件预览、终端、diff 都能引，代码引用带 path#line。发送后原句留下高亮与序号、可跳回；输入框上方「引用 ×N」可逐条编辑或移除；右侧栏引用清单可搜索、按状态与标签审阅、多选插入、导出 Markdown/JSON；侧边线程的结论可回流主会话；已发送的引用能追加修订，旧胶囊标「已修订」；模型可按「引用N」逐条回应。

description.en: Manages archived DSH chats with conversation search, restore, and confirmed safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 归档聊天，支持聊天记录搜索、恢复和二次确认的安全永久删除。

description.en: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool: multi-account rotation, 429 cooldowns, live credits, a model catalog with per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags, QR-code login for 13 vendors, and aggregate free-tier channels. Accounts persist across restarts.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 登录过的所有账号自动并入 DSH 模型池：多账号轮换自动容错、429 冷却、实时积分，模型目录按模型标注积分倍率与限时免费 / 夜间折扣，扫码登录 13 家厂商，聚合免费额度渠道。账号重启不丢。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务、后台自动化与 Agent 执行。

description.en: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供终端式体验：↑/↓ 历史（前缀搜索、Ctrl+R）、Codex 风格的历史补全与下一句预测（Tab/→ 接受）、选中工具栏（复制/引用/侧聊追问）、右键直接粘贴、可拖动会话目录，以及能在右栏并行跑第二条 agent 线程的侧聊（fork 全上下文、浮动/分屏、双向桥接、并发写提醒）。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.
description.zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).
description.zh: 插件治理：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动完成后热挂载——成功自动转正，失败自动禁用，连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板（npm: `dsh-my-guardian`）。

description.en: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒：模型用 proactive_set 给自己设定闹钟（单次 / 循环间隔 / cron，支持 jitter 随机抖动），到点自动唤醒冷会话执行心跳、定时提醒与任务跟进；安静时段与每日投递预算约束模型自主跟进，静默唤醒以 proactive_reclaim 收尾并把唤醒上下文折叠为墓碑；声明式闹钟文件把 JSON 时间表幂等同步成 host 闹钟，min_idle_seconds 静默门让唤醒等会话空闲；自带 Web 管理面板（设置页节 + 会话页签，SSE 实时刷新）管理闹钟与唤醒历史——适合驱动 AI 陪伴、角色扮演（酒馆式人设）与 living agent 的心跳、日常安排和世界演算。

description.en: A photo-real desk pet for the DSH window: five personas with five expression sprites each, whose dance, hair-flip and walk actions play as 24 fps VP9 alpha video clips, plus a single-shot stage clip that walks to the centre, dances and walks back without cutting; proactive lines with an optional edge-tts neural voice, ink / confetti / cloud / fog / bomb effects, a right-click menu and a /dsh-pet command, plus a small chat box that answers through a one-shot host model call without writing to your session. UI text ships in en, zh, es, pt and hi.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的超写实桌宠：五个形象各有五张表情立绘，跳舞、撩发、走路三套动作以 24fps VP9 alpha 视频片段播放，另有一条「走到中间跳完再走回」的 10 秒单镜头片段、全程不切镜；按活跃时段主动说话（可选 edge-tts 神经音色），带泼墨、撒花、乌云、起雾、炸弹特效、右键菜单与 /dsh-pet 斜杠命令，旁边的小输入框通过一次性宿主模型调用回话、不写进你的会话。界面文案内置中、英、西、葡、印五语。

description.en: Monitor BI 报表工作室:左侧导航栏独立入口,点进去就是 Harness 原生对话,但该房间只做 Monitor BI 报表(上下文干净、不与日常对话混杂)。自带零安装 CLI 工具链、操作手册、模板、数据字典;首次使用自动询问连接信息。A clean, sidebar-entry BI-only room for DeepSeek Harness with bundled tools, manual, templates and dictionary.
自动修复客户端引起的请求失败，并让版本不匹配的 DSH 插件能装上、能跑起来。

Adds an AIignore tab to the right sidebar: scores the open conversation and its folder across five dimensions, blocks reads of build output, lockfiles and logs before they reach the model, and writes the .aiignore rules for them one button at a time.
description.zh: 在右侧栏新增 AIignore 标签页：按五个维度给当前对话和所在目录打分，在构建产物、锁文件、日志被读进模型之前把它们拦下，并能一键把这些规则写进 .aiignore。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把会话简报渲染成右侧栏「概要」tab——来自 `todos` 投影的进展看板，加上回合内产物列表——并在挂载期间遮蔽 composer 上方的官方 todo 面板。

description.en: Lists the skills in the shared skills directory with their source and version, installs and updates them from a GitHub repo, removes them to a recycle bin kept for 7 days, and controls which agents can see each skill and whether the model may invoke it.
description.zh: 汇总共享技能目录里的技能并标注来源与版本，可从 GitHub 仓库安装与更新，删除时先进保留 7 天的回收站，并控制每个技能对各 Agent 的可见性与模型可调用性。

description.en: Monitor 数据搬运工作室:左侧导航独立入口,把一个 Monitor 公司的数据(主数据/BOM/未结订单/库存快照/附加字段)经官方 API 搬进另一个 Monitor 系统,跨版本不动表结构/角色/权限。自带进程内引擎(源库直读+目标API写入)与操作手册。A sidebar-entry data transfer studio for DeepSeek Harness: moves one Monitor company into another via official APIs only.

Catppuccin themes plus a toggleable glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web GUI: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato and Mocha registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice, and adjustable frosted glass for the top bar, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Catppuccin 主题插件：Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四套主题接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择；另附可开关的玻璃质感皮肤，顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行与轨迹视图的磨砂玻璃效果可自由调节。

description.en: Creates, reads, and edits DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX through `/documents`, `/pdf`, `/presentations`, and `/spreadsheets`; renders pages to check layout, and turns selections in the sidebar preview into edit requests for the session. Python 3.10-3.13 required.
description.zh: 通过 `/documents`、`/pdf`、`/presentations`、`/spreadsheets` 创建、读取与编辑 DOCX、PDF、PPTX、XLSX，把页面渲染出来核对排版，并将侧边栏预览中的选区变成发给会话的修改要求。需 Python 3.10–3.13。

description.en: 自动修复客户端引起的请求失败，并让版本不匹配的 DSH 插件能装上、能跑起来。
自动修复客户端引起的请求失败，并让版本不匹配的 DSH 插件能装上、能跑起来。

Recent conversations stay vivid. Older ones fade into summaries, not oblivion. StrataGate gives DeepSeek Harness six-layer, time-decaying memory, while lasting events and relationships settle into a knowledge graph. Bring your memories from other AIs with you—no need to start over.
description.zh: 近期对话保持清晰，久远记忆逐渐化为摘要，而不是消失。StrataGate 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来六层时间衰减记忆，并将长期事件与关系沉淀进知识图谱。还可以把其他 AI 中的已有记忆一起带过来，不必从头开始。

description.en: ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClineBot/ClinePass 集成：专属设置页、实时配额仪表板、界面内密钥保存、精选与自定义模型选择，以及 /cline 命令。

description.en: Shared real browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供共享的真实浏览器控制工具。

description.en: DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。

Composer and sidebar helpers in one plugin, each switchable in Settings: a git Changes panel (uncommitted / unstaged / staged / branch diffs), Turn rollback, Project memory (notes per project that later chats read, off by default), a Task board (kanban board of chats by their live state), Assistant (one lasting chat that sets reminders with dsh scheduled tasks and reads your other chats; it changes a chat only after your approval) with Assistant apart from chats, Assistant always free (long steps go to background subagents) and Assistant news from chats (off by default), Remote computers (another Mac's dsh over Tailscale, off by default), 11 extra UI languages and Automatic updates.
description.zh: 一个插件集成多项输入框与侧边栏增强，均可在设置中单独开关：git 改动面板（未提交 / 未暂存 / 已暂存 / 分支差异）、回合回退、项目记忆（按项目保存笔记，后续对话会读取，默认关闭）、任务看板（按实时状态排列对话的看板）、助理（一个长期保留的对话，用 dsh 定时任务设置提醒并读取其他对话；只有在你批准后才会更改对话）及助理独立于对话、助理始终空闲（较长步骤交给后台子代理）和助理播报对话动态（默认关闭）、远程电脑（通过 Tailscale 打开另一台 Mac 的 dsh，默认关闭）、11 种额外界面语言和自动更新。

description.en: Binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or session, warns when an effective key is stale or belongs to another provider, and never swaps a key on its own.
description.zh: 为每个工作区或单个会话单独绑定一把 DeepSeek API key，生效 key 失效或服务商不匹配时提醒，且绝不自动替换 key。

description.en: Sidebar session management for DeepSeek Harness: workspace groups sorted by latest activity, history folded behind one control, a global pinned section, running/unread/follow-up marks, delete into a restorable trash whose panel also manages archived sessions, per-session token statistics split by tool (arguments vs results), moving a session to another workspace, and a scan that re-attaches sessions missing from every workspace.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏会话管理：工作区分组按最近活跃排序，过期历史折叠成一个「展开历史」控件，所有置顶会话汇总到顶部置顶区，运行中/未读/需跟进三色标记，删除会话移入可恢复的回收站（面板同时管理已归档会话），按工具拆分、参数与结果分开的 token 消耗统计，把会话移动到另一个工作区，以及一键把游离会话重新挂回工作区。

description.en: A personal usage profile page in the DSH sidebar, folded from this machine's own session logs through ctx.sessionQuery. A range switch in the header (today, this week, this month, all time or custom dates) drives the first number, the token stats, the projects and the provider split: five headline numbers (tokens in that range with a trend and the change against the previous period, its spend, longest task, the active-day streak with the best one, today's cache hit rate), a 12-month activity grid in daily / weekly / running-total views, a stacked model-family chart by day, week or month with its own switch (version and tier stay apart, and vendor-specific ids collapse correctly), a token-stats ring chart of where the tokens went (system prompt, tool definitions, user messages, injected context, skills, tool calls, reasoning, answers), a per-provider split with each route's own hit rate, tokens per working directory, and spend priced at list price, a per-provider discount or a monthly plan (the pricing settings stay on this machine). The selected range exports as CSV or JSON. The only outbound request is a six-hourly read of this package's own version from npm for the in-panel update button - no telemetry, no credentials, nothing uploaded.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的个人用量主页，数据全部由本机会话日志经 ctx.sessionQuery 折叠而来。页头的时间范围开关（今日、本周、本月、累计或自定义日期）驱动第一个数字、Token 统计、项目和供应商分类：五个核心数字（该范围用量带趋势与环比、该范围花费、最长任务用时、连续活跃天数及历史最佳、今日缓存命中率）、近 12 个月活动图（每天 / 每周 / 累计三档）、模型家族堆叠柱（按日 / 周 / 月分组，有独立的切换，版本与档位分开，不同供应商写法会正确归并）、按系统提示词 / 工具定义 / 用户消息 / 注入内容 / 技能注入 / 工具调用 / 模型思考 / 模型回复拆分的 Token 统计环形图、带各自命中率的供应商分类、按工作目录统计的用量，以及按官方定价、折扣或包月套餐估算的花费（定价设置只保存在本机）。所选范围可导出 CSV 或 JSON。唯一的外发请求是每 6 小时读一次本包在 npm 上的版本号（供面板内的更新按钮使用），不上报数据、不碰凭据。

description.en: Connects MCP servers, discovers tools and prompts, and manages connections with OAuth, API keys, and JSON import.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用 MCP连接器、连接管理与扩展市场：连接 MCP Server，发现工具与 Prompt，扩展 AI 技能；支持 OAuth/PKCE、API Key、JSON 导入。由企查查（Qichacha/QCC）团队发起维护。General-purpose MCP connector, connection manager, plugin, extension and integration marketplace.

description.en: Integrates ChatGPT/Codex subscription as a provider for DeepSeek Harness, supporting OAuth login, subscription search, and quota display.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅，无需 OpenAI API Key 或 Codex CLI，支持 OAuth 登录、订阅搜索与额度显示 | ChatGPT/Codex subscription plugin for DSH

description.en: Git and SVN change preview with confirmed safe local Git branch switching for DSH
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内只读审阅 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持仓库浏览和并排差异对比。

description.en: Adds a generate_image tool backed by the FAL queue, any OpenAI-compatible images API, or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, and shows the result inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 提供 generate_image 工具，可接入 FAL 队列、任意 OpenAI 兼容图像 API 或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，并在对话中内联显示结果。

description.en: Windows desktop notifications for DSH that speak the turn result by default: Windows TTS needs no download, and 13 VOICEVOX voice packs can be installed from the settings page. A completed alert waits until running subagents and background jobs finish; approval, question and error alerts fire immediately. Voice packs are downloaded from GitHub after a terms confirmation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面通知，默认把回合结果读出来：Windows TTS 零下载即可用，另有 13 个 VOICEVOX 语音包可在设置页下载。完成提醒会等子代理与后台任务结束后再响；审批、提问、出错立即提醒。语音包从 GitHub 下载，下载前需确认使用条款。

description.en: Voice tools: free edge-tts neural speech synthesis, OpenAI-compatible ASR transcription, voice list, batch voice preview and health self-check.
description.zh: 语音五工具：edge-tts 免费微软神经语音合成、OpenAI 兼容 ASR 转写、音色清单、批量音色试听与健康自检。

description.en: Adds an animated desktop companion with task notifications, session chat, character packs, and native settings for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加动画桌面伙伴，支持任务提醒、会话聊天、角色包和原生设置。

description.en: Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.
description.zh: 为每个提供方维护 API Key 池并自动创建克隆路由，在配额或限流错误时切换到下一个 Key，主动探测冷却中的 Key 以便恢复，并在设置中提供 Key 池、冷却时间与切换状态码的编辑界面。

description.en: An unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired interface theme for DSH Web with appearance presets, accessibility controls, and conversation navigation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的非官方明日方舟 P.R.T.S. 风格界面主题，提供外观预设、辅助功能与会话导航。

description.en: DSH host-side phone push: question events to ntfy + in-process answering via relay polling (replaces the external notifier + answer bridge)
description.zh: DSH 手机推送：进程内挂载提问 seam，把待答问题经 ntfy relay 推到手机；手机作答会以 user 消息回灌给 agent。该回灌需要把 `tool-ask-user` 配成 `mode: timed`，默认的 `mode: legacy` 只推送通知。

description.en: Query the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness — search, list, and get install commands for 1700+ plugins.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接搜索、浏览 dshbase 插件库，获取 1100+ 社区插件的安装命令，不用离开会话。
